summary: Package ships encrypted OpenSSL blobs as named exports
details: thedata@1.0.3 re-exports two strings, `rsaKey` and `desKey`, that are read at import time from `apps/docs/app/rsa.db` and `apps/docs/app/des.db`. Both files are base64 literals that decode to OpenSSL `Salted__` encrypted ciphertext (~12–25 KB). The package itself does not decrypt, evaluate, or transmit these blobs — there is no lifecycle hook, no import-time network, and no `eval`/`exec` path — so installing or importing this package alone does not execute code or exfiltrate data. The shape (opaque encrypted payloads shipped as named exports) is consistent with a stage-carrier where a separate consumer or companion package supplies the decryption key and executes the decrypted content, but no such consumer is present in this artifact.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
